goals.title: Implement minimal LLVM CIR fix for member-pointer zero-initialization...
goals.objective: Implement minimal LLVM CIR fix for member-pointer zero-initialization soundness. Deliverable: patch only scoped files if possible so clang/test/CIR/CodeGen/nonzeroinit-struct.cpp fails-loud for non-zero-initializable Itanium data member pointers. Success criteria: (1) RED evidence from build/bin/llvm-lit -sv clang/test/CIR/CodeGen/nonzeroinit-struct.cpp before patch shows cc1 succeeds and FileCheck fails; (2) GREEN evidence after patch from ninja -C build clang and build/bin/llvm-lit -sv clang/test/CIR/CodeGen/nonzeroinit-struct.cpp; (3) manual CLI QA via tmux reruns the exact lit command and captures transcript showing PASS; (4) git diff/status evidence shows only intended scoped tracked files changed and unrelated existing edits untouched.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI RED: run build/bin/llvm-lit -sv clang/test/CIR/CodeGen/nonzeroinit-struct.cpp before code edits; PASS iff output contains FAIL and FileCheck reports missing NYI while cc1 emitted #cir.zero.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: RED: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/member-pointer-red-live.txt shows FAIL, emitted #cir.zero, LIT_EXIT:1 | cleanup: no runtime resources

successCriteria.scenario: CLI GREEN: run ninja -C build clang, then build/bin/llvm-lit -sv clang/test/CIR/CodeGen/nonzeroinit-struct.cpp after patch; PASS iff ninja exits 0 and lit reports Passed: 1.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: GREEN: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/member-pointer-ninja.txt has NINJA_EXIT:0; .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/member-pointer-green.txt has Passed: 1 and LIT_EXIT:0 | cleanup: no runtime resources

successCriteria.scenario: tmux manual QA: create tmux session ulw-qa-member-pointer, send build/bin/llvm-lit -sv clang/test/CIR/CodeGen/nonzeroinit-struct.cpp; printf EXIT:$?; capture pane; PASS iff transcript contains Passed: 1 and EXIT:0, then kill session and confirm it is gone.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: tmux QA: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/member-pointer-tmux-qa.txt has Passed: 1 and EXIT:0 | cleanup: killed tmux session ulw-qa-member-pointer; confirmed absent
